wpPortfolio.title: GOOD GROWTH HUB
wpPortfolio.content:
In August 2021, I built a fresh and modern looking website for the Good Growth Hub, which brings together people and businesses in east London to offer career opportunities, training and new talent to local businesses.

The client wanted a site that was quick, secure and easy to update so I developed it as a Headless WordPress website using GatsbyJS and hosted on Netlify, which provides the user with a fully functioning and simple CMS but also provides higher security and performance than a standard WordPress website.
